nav.limits: What it does and does not do
home.title: Vessel
home.lead: A VPN run by the anoni.net community. It uses AmneziaWG with obfuscation, which makes it harder to recognize on networks that block VPNs. No email needed, and keys are generated in your browser.
home.inviteOnly: Invites come from community members only, and places are limited.
how.title: How it works
how.1.title: Redeem an invite
how.1.body: Enter your invite code and you get a 16-digit account number. You sign in with it from then on.
how.2.title: Add a device
how.2.body: Pick the city of the node and name the device. Keys are generated in your browser, and the private key never reaches the community's servers.
how.3.title: Import into the app
how.3.body: Scan the QR code with the AmneziaWG app or import the downloaded file, then switch it on.
limits.title: What it does and does not do
limits.can.1: Your network provider sees only that you connect to a Vessel node, not where you go from there
limits.can.2: The connection is obfuscated, so it is less likely to be recognized and blocked as a VPN
limits.can.3: Reach sites that are blocked on your network
limits.cannot.1: Make you anonymous: the community's nodes can see which domains you connect to. Use Tor Browser when you need anonymity
limits.cannot.2: Hide your accounts: once you sign in to Google or Facebook, they still know it is you
limits.cannot.3: Guarantee it works on every network, since blocking keeps changing
data.title: What we keep
data.kept.1: A hash of your account number, which cannot be turned back into the number
data.kept.2: When the account was created and last signed in to
data.kept.3: Each device's name, public key, city and expiry date
data.notKept.1: Email, phone number or any other contact details
data.notKept.3: Where you connect to, or when
data.cloudflare: This site goes through Cloudflare, which can see visitors' IP addresses and the pages they view.
data.details: Details are in the privacy policy

redeem.label: Invite code
redeem.hint: It looks like ABCD-EFGH-JKMN-PQRS. Upper or lower case both work.
number.title: Your account is ready
number.lead: This is your account number. You sign in with it.
number.label: Account number
number.warnTitle: You will only see this number once
number.warnBody: The community has no email address for you, so a lost number cannot be recovered. You would need a new invite code.
number.saved: I have stored the number somewhere safe
number.locked: Tick the box above to continue
login.title: Sign in

devices.title: My devices
devices.usageNote: Shared by the account's devices, reset on the 1st of each month (UTC)
devices.emptyBody: Add a device to start using Vessel.
devices.limitNote: Up to {max} devices per account, {quota} a month shared between them. Signing in extends them by 30 days
devices.confirmDelete: Delete “{name}”? The device disconnects right away.
status.pendingNote: The node is adding this device. This usually takes less than a minute.

account.title: Account
account.deleteBody: Deleting the account deletes all its devices, which disconnect right away, and the account number stops working. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteCheck: I understand this cannot be undone

new.title: Add a device
install.title: Install AmneziaWG first
install.body: Vessel needs AmneziaWG; the regular WireGuard® app cannot connect. If you already have it, update to the latest version first, since older versions cannot connect after importing.
install.detected: Your browser looks like {platform}. Switch if that is wrong.
install.android.apk: No Google Play? Download the APK
install.apple.store: Get it on the App Store
install.apple.note: Needs iOS 15 or later. AmneziaWG is not in the App Store in some regions, and iPhones have no other way to install it for now.
install.windows.note: Most computers need the file with amd64 in its name.
pick.title: Choose a city
pick.body: A city near you is usually faster.
name.title: Name the device
name.label: Device name
name.hint: Only you see the name; it tells your devices apart. Avoid your real name or anything that identifies you, since anyone who gets into the account sees it too.
filter.title: Domain filtering
filter.malware.desc: A malware list with few false positives
filter.ads.desc: Adds ad and tracker lists, which occasionally block a legitimate site
filter.doh: Browsers with “secure DNS” turned on skip this setting. To change it later, create the device again.
name.keysNote: When you press “Create config”, the keys are generated in this browser. The private key never reaches the community's servers.
config.title: Import into AmneziaWG
config.waiting: The node is adding this device. Please wait and stay on this page.
config.qrShow: Using another device? Show the QR code
config.warn: Once you leave this page the config cannot be shown again. The private key exists only on this screen, not on the community's servers.
import.android.1: Download the config with the button above
import.android.2: Open AmneziaWG and tap + at the bottom right
import.android.3: Choose to import from a file and pick the one you downloaded
import.android.4: Switch it on; the first time, allow the VPN connection
import.apple.1: Download the config with the button above
import.apple.2: Open AmneziaWG and tap + at the top right
import.apple.3: Choose to import from a file and pick the one you downloaded
import.apple.4: Switch it on; the first time, allow adding the VPN configuration
import.windows.1: Download the config with the button above
import.windows.2: Open AmneziaWG and choose to import a tunnel from a file
import.windows.3: Pick the file you downloaded and press Activate
